row:
Gentle Storm Horse Sanctuary exists to rescue horses trapped in auction pipelines and facing slaughter in Mexico.
These horses often come from lives of neglect, overwork, abuse, and abandonment — sold through auctions and pushed toward slaughterhouses with no voice and no time left.

We are the gentle storm that steps in.
When chaos, fear, and cruelty surround them, we intervene with urgency, compassion, and unwavering commitment.

At our sanctuary, rescued horses receive:
• Emergency rescue from auctions and slaughter routes
• Medical care, rehabilitation, and trauma recovery
• Safety, patience, and respect
• A chance to heal after the storm has passed

They have survived the storm.
Now they deserve gentleness.
